name: Guilherme Bernardo da Nóbrega
heroSubtitle: I build systems and automations that scale with governance, security, and continuous evolution.

aboutMe.intro: I work on the architecture and development of digital systems with a focus on automation, integration, and scalability. I operate at the intersection of technology and business, taking technical responsibility for products and critical infrastructures. Currently working with identity (OIDC), process automation, and module integration in institutional environments.

cases.title: Hospital do Olho - Intranet / Identity / Integration
cases.problem: Need to centralize access to multiple internal systems, integrate legacy systems, modernize intranet, implement monitoring trackers and Ombudsman HelpDesk.
cases.solution: Architecture with SSO via OIDC, API integrations between systems, unified portal for all modules.
cases.result: Better governance and access control, increased productivity with reduced rework, standardization of processes and interfaces.

cases.title: E-commerce at Scale (Wicomm)
cases.problem: VTEX/WAKE stores needing complex customizations while maintaining performance.
cases.solution: Custom components, ERP integrations, checkout optimization.
cases.result: 4 stores delivered (AD Fashion, Toy Mania, King & Joe, Ladeira Bijuterias).

cases.title: Process Automation
cases.problem: Repetitive manual processes consuming team time.
cases.solution: Automated workflows for system integration and notifications.
cases.result: Automation of operational flows, time savings on manual tasks.
